ih_inflam_eze_plus.name: Inflam-Eze Plus
ih_inflam_eze_plus.key: Per 3 capsules: 800 mg ginger, 250 mg CurQfen curcumin-fenugreek (35% curcuminoids), 250 mg boswellia, 200 mg white willow extract, 150 mg hops, 60 mg devil's claw
ih_inflam_eze_plus.src: Inflam-Eze Plus sell sheet Rev. 5/25 ND516 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, read for labels.json): ginger powder 800 mg; 'Proprietary Mix of Curcumin Extract (35% curcuminoids) and Fenugreek Galactomannans Extract (CurQfen)' 250 mg; Boswellia serrata gum extract (65% boswellic acid) 250 mg; 'White Willow Extract (bark; Salix alba; 25% salicin)' 200 mg; hops extract (2% xanthohumol) 150 mg; devil's claw extract (1.2% harpagosides) 60 mg; 'Take 3 capsules once daily with food'. Products DB R856 (catalog ND143 10/1/26 via the switch charts) confirms ginger 800, CurQfen 250 (35%), boswellia 250 (65%), hops 150 and the directions; the DB omits willow and devil's claw, the sell sheet panel is printed. Sizes R856 90C / R856L 180C from the ND144 price list 10/1/26. URL slug from products.py SLUGS (60-day protocol doc).

ih_prm_resolve.name: PRM Resolve
ih_prm_resolve.key: Per 2 softgels: 400 mcg PRMs (pro-resolving mediators), 1,200 mg omega-3 with 580 mg EPA and 420 mg DHA
ih_prm_resolve.src: PRM Resolve sell sheet Rev. 1/25 ND447 (labels.json): 'Total PRMs [including 18-HEPE, 17-HDHA, 14-HDHA]' 400 mcg, total omega-3 1,200 mg, EPA 580 mg, DHA 420 mg per 2 softgels; 'Take two softgels daily'; 'Contains: Fish (anchovy, sardine, squid, and mackerel)' (drives the fish or shellfish line in the check panel). Same amounts in products DB R848 (Metagenics and Microbiome Labs charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Sizes R848 60S / R848L 120S, ND144 price list. URL from the repo blast blasts/2026-09-22-head-injury-six.html. 'With your evening meal' is the sheet's schedule suggestion, not label text.

ih_collagen_renew.name: Collagen Renew
ih_collagen_renew.key: Per scoop: 17.5 g collagen peptides (FORTIGEL 5 g, FORTIBONE 5 g, TENDOFORTE 5 g, VERISOL 2.5 g), 15 g protein
ih_collagen_renew.dosesub: in 8 oz of water or a drink
ih_collagen_renew.src: Collagen Renew sell sheet Rev. 9/24 ND569 (labels.json): 17.5 g collagen peptides per scoop (FORTIGEL 5 g, FORTIBONE 5 g, TENDOFORTE 5 g, VERISOL 2.5 g), 15 g protein, about 30 servings, 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water, your favorite beverage, or a recipe'. Products DB R190 (5 charts) agrees. The label states no daily frequency or timing; 1 scoop a day in the morning is the sheet's plan, and the column no longer adds a second timing (before exercise) that could disagree with the rhythm panel. No vitamin C in the formula (blast 2026-10-19-collagen-tendon), so the sheet pairs it with a vitamin C food. Size R190 525G, ND144 price list. URL from that blast.

ih_muscle_eze.name: Muscle Eze
ih_muscle_eze.key: Per 3 capsules: 200 mg magnesium (citrate), 100 mg calcium (lactate), 50 mg L-theanine, 40 mg passion flower
ih_muscle_eze.src: Muscle Eze sell sheet Rev. 7/26 ND433 (labels.json): calcium (as lactate) 100 mg, magnesium (as citrate) 200 mg, L-theanine 50 mg, passion flower 40 mg per 3 capsules; 'Adults take three capsules daily'; caution 'may cause drowsiness'. Bedtime timing and URL from the repo blast blasts/2026-09-22-muscle-guarding.html ('three capsules at bedtime'). Size R884 90C, ND144 price list.

ih_nerve_eze.name: Nerve Eze
ih_nerve_eze.key: Per capsule: 300 mg PEA (palmitoylethanolamide, as Levagen+), 150 mg alpha lipoic acid
ih_nerve_eze.src: NOT ON THE SHEET since polish round 1 (column 5 is ih_whey_protein); kept so the column can be restored once the R184 print master, the product page and a catalog cross-check exist. Nerve Eze sell sheet Rev. 8/24 ND633 (labels.json): palmitoylethanolamide (PEA, Levagen+) 300 mg and alpha lipoic acid 150 mg per capsule; 'Take one capsule twice daily'. Size R184 60C, ND144 price list. SINGLE SOURCE: the products DB has no R184 label facts, and the ND143 10/1/26 catalog (Dropbox Catalog and Order Forms, wCover_ND143_Catalog_All_10_1_26.pdf, 57.7 MB) is over the Dropbox text-read limit and its download host is blocked from this session, so the panel is not yet confirmed against the catalog. No verified product-page slug (nutridyn.com is blocked from this session), so the link falls back to the nutridyn.com catalog search. ih_whey_protein.name: Whey Protein
ih_whey_protein.key: Per scoop (32 g): 25 g protein from whey protein isolate, with 2.65 g leucine
ih_whey_protein.src: Products DB R372L (Nutri-West Complete Whey-G and Biotics Research Whey Protein Isolate switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26): 'NutriDyn 25 g (1 scoop, 32 g, whey protein isolate)'; 'label directions per day: NutriDyn 1 serving'; directions 'Mix 1 scoop in 8-10 ounces of water as a dietary supplement or as directed by your healthcare practitioner'; SKUs R372L 896G (Chocolate) and R373L 909G (Vanilla), 10/1/26 price list (the size line names the two flavors; the weights do not fit one line); DB note 'Whey Protein is dairy-based' (drives the milk line in the check panel). Leucine 2.65 g per scoop and 'grass-fed, rBGH-free' from the repo blasts blasts/2026-10-26-glp1-protein-chooser.html ('Every leucine number read off the nutridyn.com label 2026-10-21') and blasts/2026-09-22-peptide-nutrient-gap.html ('2.65 g of leucine in one scoop'); the bottle photo reads 'Bioactive Whey Protein Isolate with BCAAs', 'Supports Lean Body Mass' and 'Complete Protein Source'. URL https://nutridyn.com/dynamic-whey-protein from both blasts. The evening-meal slot is the sheet's plan (it spreads protein away from the morning Collagen Renew scoop; peptide-nutrient-gap blast: 'Spread the protein out'), not label text.
